day5_ending_forget_forced_1.text: *It's already too late. Only the cold mark where the needle was remains.*

day5_ending_forget_forced_3.text: *Nurse Riin closed her eyes. She said something, but the sound was distant, like underwater.*

day5_ending_forget_forced_4.text: *My consciousness sinks. Neither anger nor words will come.*

day5_ending_ghost_guided_1.text: *Amidst the blackout, the emergency bell rang once. Someone roughly shoves my back.*

day5_ending_ghost_guided_2.text: ...Don't stop. Your body remembers the way.

day5_ending_ghost_guided_3.text: *I ran up the stairs two at a time. Seolhwa seems to be leading. My feet are already headed for the emergency exit.*

day5_ending_ghost_guided_4.text: Good. Keep going. Now, just push the door.

day5_ending_ghost_guided_5.text: *The door opened, and cold air rushed in. That's when I finally caught my breath.*

day5_ending_true_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu's hand trembles. The fingers gripping the syringe are white.*

day5_ending_true_3.text: ...okay. It's the door again this time.

day5_ending_true_4.text: *Ms. Eunsu sets the syringe down and steps away from the emergency exit.*

day5_ending_true_5.text: *Yuna and I pass through the emergency exit onto the fire escape behind the old wing. The late-night air is cold. Streetlights line the road beyond the school fence.*

day5_ending_true_7.text:
*Seolhwa is standing inside the emergency exit. She can't step outside the door.*

Come with us. Could you get out if I held your hand?

day5_ending_true_11.text: *Seolhwa smiles. The emergency light passes through her face and lights the tiles behind her.*

day5_ending_true_12.text: Six times, I stopped here. Don't look back today.

day5_ending_true_13.text: My record ends here. You go through the door.

day5_ending_true_14.text: Lee Seolhwa. I’ll remember that name.

day5_ending_true_14a.text: *Inside the building, Ms. Eunsu’s footsteps recede.*

day5_ending_true_14b.text: *Yuna takes hold of my sleeve. Seolhwa is still standing just inside the doorway.*

day5_ending_true_15.text: *Seolhwa stopped. She looked back. Light glistened at the corners of her eyes, but the corners of her mouth were turned up.*

day5_ending_true_16.text: That’s the first time you’ve called me that.

day5_ending_true_17.text: *The outline of Seolhwa becomes blurred. Only the light remains on the stairs.*

day5_ending_true_18.text: *The smell of rainy stairs, a wet uniform sleeve, the cold hand that held my left -- all of it rushes in at once.*

day5_ending_true_19.text: *For an instant, scenes rush in with no order at all.*

day5_ending_true_20.text: *The rain at the library, the locked basement door, the hand I held while climbing over the fence. They come back one after another.*

day5_ending_true_21.text: *All twelve name tags in my memory are turned face down.*

day5_ending_true_21a.text: *Minsu’s profile picture is a blank gray image. I cannot recall my old classroom or why my parents moved. Only scenes of this school remain.*

day5_ending_true_22.text:
*As I drop to my knees, Yuna sits beside me and supports my back.*

Wait. Hold me. I can see the road, but I can't stand.

day5_ending_true_24.text:
Let's go. We'll keep talking outside. I don't want to stay here.

*Yuna looks across the dark sports field, toward the road outside the school fence, and speaks.*

day5_ending_true_26.text: *A news article. 'Unlicensed Research Facility Discovered at XX High School -- Allegations of Illegal Drug Administration and Human Clinical Trials'*

day5_ending_true_27.text: *'Multiple victims report memory disorders... Lead researcher B arrested' '3-year student C, who collected evidence while enrolled, played a decisive role in the expose'*

day5_ending_true_28.text: *I put down my phone. A new school, a new classroom. No familiar faces.*

day5_ending_true_29.text: *I looked at the name tag. My name. ...Not the 13th name, but the first one.*

day5_ending_true_30.text: *I copy the names onto paper. Seolhwa's name and every face that remains go on the same line.*

day5_ending_true_31.text: *I take the pencil in my left hand. A graphite mark forms beside my index finger.*

day5_postcredit_2.text: *A spacious office. Stacks of documents on a desk. Multiple monitors. A school blueprint on the screen.*

day5_postcredit_3.text: Yes. Confirmed. The site will be closed. Asset recovery is complete, personnel will be reassigned.

day5_postcredit_4.text: Close Case 13 at the site manager level. Do not leave the foundation's name behind.

day5_postcredit_5.text: ...Yes. The selection of the next pilot school is complete.

day5_postcredit_6.text: Has the staff reassignment proposal been submitted?

day5_postcredit_7.text: *The monitor screen changes. New school. New school uniform. New names. File title: 'Edina Foundation - Maladjusted Student Correction Program 2nd Base Implementation Plan'. The logo at the top of the document remains the same.*

day5_postcredit_8.text: *...A new transfer student's profile appears on screen. The student in the photo is smiling. With a face that knows nothing.*

day5_ending_escape_1.text: *I ran. With Yuna. Escaped the school.*

day5_ending_escape_2.text: *I looked back. No one is following.*

day5_ending_escape_3.text: *Even after I got outside the school gate, I could not stop running for a while.*

day5_ending_escape_4.text: Sunbae, we don’t have the documents. Just the photos on the camera.

day5_ending_escape_6.text: *I walked. The predawn road. Under a streetlight.*

day5_ending_escape_7.text: *...My head is quiet. Only the spot where Seolhwa had been standing stays blank.*

day5_ending_escape_8.text: *When I look back toward the school, only one third-floor window in the old building is dark and empty.*

day5_ending_escape_11.text:
*Yuna opens her mouth, then readjusts her grip on her bag strap without saying anything.*

Why? Was that a strange answer? Weren't you just asking?

day5_ending_escape_12.text: *...I was gripping the bag strap with my left hand. Unconsciously.*

day5_ending_escape_14.text: *I typed ○○ High School into the news search bar. No new articles appeared.*

day5_ending_escape_15.text: Sunbae. They say a new transfer student arrived at that school today.

day5_ending_resist_2.text: This probably isn’t your first signature. But you shouldn’t sign any more.

day5_ending_resist_4.text: No. From the 3rd time on, it was my choice.

day5_ending_resist_5.text: Every signature after that is in my handwriting, {name}.

day5_ending_resist_6.text: If you stay here, another student will end up in that seat.

day5_ending_resist_7.text: *Ms. Eunsu stops. Seolhwa appears—not behind her, but superimposed over my field of vision.*

day5_ending_resist_9.text: *The name leaves my mouth without thinking. Ms. Eunsu lowers the hand holding the syringe.*

day5_ending_resist_11.text:
*I speak Seolhwa’s words aloud.*

You smiled every time a new name tag went up.

day5_ending_resist_12.text: And each time, the smile lasted less and less.

day5_ending_resist_13.text: You need to leave too, ma’am.

day5_ending_resist_14.text:
*Ms. Eunsu sets the syringe on the floor and stands there for a long time.*

Don't pick it up again. The door is open. Let's go together.

day5_ending_resist_15.text: ...Once I go outside, every document will have my name on it.

day5_ending_resist_18a.text: The 11th Oh Taehyun... said he trusted me. That it was all right because I was his teacher.

day5_ending_resist_18b.text:
*Ms. Eunsu can’t finish the sentence. She closes her mouth.*

He trusted you. What did you do?

day5_ending_resist_18c.text: ...I erased it that night. The next morning, that student asked, 'Who are you, teacher?'

day5_ending_resist_18d.text: Even so, I signed. On the next line, and the one after that.

day5_ending_resist_19.text:
*Ms. Eunsu covers her mouth and cannot raise her head for a while.*

Look at me. I know. Going outside won't make the papers disappear.

day5_ending_resist_20.text: ...I erased you with my own hands. And yet?

day5_ending_resist_21.text: Once we get these records outside, you'll be held responsible. But that's better than writing the next line here.

day5_ending_resist_22.text:
*I pass through the emergency exit with Ms. Eunsu.*

*Seolhwa smiles from behind the door, her outline dissolving into the light on the stairs.*

day5_ending_resist_23.text: *Ms. Eunsu got out. But the stamp at the top of the documents remains.*

day5_ending_resist_24.text: *In the empty faculty room, a new homeroom teacher nameplate is set down. And at the empty desk -- a new transfer student.*

day5_ending_resist_subtitle.text: Defiance — Records Handed Over to the Outside.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_1.text:
*Night has fallen, but the classroom lights are still on. Ms. Eunsu sorts the attendance register as usual.*

Still looking at the register? Class is over. Can't we turn the lights off? Sitting here under all this light is a bit…

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_3.text: *I nodded. The words that had risen all the way up my throat sank back down.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_4.text: Starting tomorrow, just go back to normal. Same seat as in the attendance book.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_5.text: *The classroom door closed softly. Even knowing it wasn't locked, I didn't get up from my seat.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_6.text: *...The next afternoon. The same classroom, the same window seat. Ms. Eunsu's voice rings faintly, like a bell.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_7.text: *The same class every day. The same classroom every day. The same smile every day.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_8.text: *A car passes outside the window. I don't get up from my seat.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_9.text: *I looked out the window. The road beyond the fence. A car passes.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_11.text: *I could leave, but I don’t get up from the chair.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_3.text: I can stay here today, right?

day5_ending_cage_sea_4.text:
*I only nod. Sea rests her forehead on my shoulder and lets out a long breath.*

Yeah. I'll stay today. Just loosen your grip a little.

day5_ending_cage_sea_6.text: *...The student council room. Sea opened a lunchbox. She looks at me and smiles.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_7.text: *The thirteenth. Sea doesn't close the lunchbox. The seat across from her remains occupied.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_8.text: *Yuna's camera is not by the library window. Only the habit of touching the left wall every night remains.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_9.text: *Inside the desk drawer, one name tag still remains empty.*

day5_ending_cage_subtitle.text: Cage — The Seat I Chose to Stay In.

day5_ending_forget_4.text: All those blanks are my records, aren’t they?

day5_ending_forget_5.text: I can't. I don't think I can walk out carrying all those names.

day5_ending_forget_6.text: Please erase it. I keep seeing the names.

day5_ending_forget_7.text:
*Ms. Eunsu raises the syringe and brings it toward my arm.*

Can I close my eyes?

day5_ending_forget_9.text: *Numbness spreads through my arm from where the needle went in.*

day5_ending_forget_10.text: *Last seen — Seolhwa. The mouth moves. There is no sound.*

day5_ending_forget_11.text: *...I can read it. The movement of her lips.*

day5_ending_forget_14.text: *...It's bright. An alarm is ringing. I looked at my phone.*

day5_ending_forget_16.text: *The name is different. The face in the mirror looks familiar, but I can’t remember what to call it.*

day5_ending_forget_17.text: *My chin is wet. The thought of wiping it comes a beat late.*

day5_ending_forget_18.text: *I need to go to school. A new school.*

day5_ending_forget_19.text: *A teacher is standing at the school gate.*

day5_ending_forget_20.text: Welcome. You're {new_name}, right? The transfer student?

day5_ending_forget_21.text: I'll look after your school life from now on.

day5_ending_forget_22.text: *Ms. Eunsu smiles warmly. The corners of her mouth and eyes rise in perfect unison.*

day5_ending_forget_sea_1.text: *A girl is standing at the school gate. A bright smile. Class representative armband.*

day5_ending_forget_sea_2.text: Hi! You're the new transfer student, right? I'll show you around.

day5_ending_forget_sea_3.text: *...This person looks familiar. Where was it? ...I cannot remember.*

day5_ending_ghost_1.text: *My feet won't lift, as if they're stuck to the floor.*

day5_ending_ghost_3.text: *...Seolhwa appeared. Between me and Ms. Eunsu.*

day5_ending_ghost_7.text: Your feet stopped again. So this time, I stepped in front.

day5_ending_ghost_8.text: This time, I'll push you forward.

day5_ending_ghost_9.text:
*Seolhwa looks straight at me. I’ve never seen that look in any of the photos so far.*

Look outside, not at me. Are you looking at me like that because you mean to send only me out?

day5_ending_ghost_11.text: *My body moved. My toes turned toward the emergency exit.*

day5_ending_ghost_12.text: *I grabbed Yuna's hand and ran for the emergency exit. Ms. Eunsu shouted from behind but I didn't stop.*

day5_ending_ghost_13.text: *Outside the emergency exit, I look back. Seolhwa is smiling inside the door. I can see the wall through her.*

day5_ending_ghost_14.text: ...teacher. Next, there is no name tag.

day5_ending_ghost_15.text: *Seolhwa vanished. Soundlessly. At the same time, an alarm rang inside the building. Sirens, footsteps, and shouts tangled together.*

day5_ending_ghost_16.text: *Seolhwa's voice could no longer be heard. I escaped the school. Behind me, sirens wailed.*

day5_ending_ghost_17.text: *Even after transferring schools, I still avoid empty seats and touch the wall with my left hand.*

day5_ending_ghost_18.text: *Sometimes at night, when I look in the mirror, dark brown hair passes by one beat late.*

day5_ending_ghost_19.text: *When I pick up a pencil or turn left in a hallway, someone’s name comes to mind, then disappears.*

day5_ending_ghost_20.text: *Only the stroke bending left and the scratch on the second stair remain clear.*

day5_ending_ghost_21.text: *My left hand finds the rail first; I follow the left wall in corridors.*

day5_ending_ghost_22.text: *That school is still there. A new lock hangs on the emergency exit, and the key is in another hand.*

day5_ending_complicit_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu held out a piece of paper.*

day5_ending_complicit_2.text: You take charge of the next child. Then you can stay.

day5_ending_complicit_3.text: stay here I'll move the name to the top.

day5_ending_complicit_5.text: *I looked at the paper. 'Project Nevergrad -- Assistant Researcher Contract.'*

day5_ending_complicit_6.text: ...When the next child comes, can I smile at the front door too?

day5_ending_complicit_8.text: *I placed my hand on the contract.*

day5_ending_complicit_8a.text: *The edge of the paper catches against my palm.*

day5_ending_complicit_8b.text: *I can see the door handle. But my gaze stays on the signature line.*

day5_ending_complicit_sign.text: *The tip of the pen touches the signature line.*

day5_ending_complicit_12.text: *In the morning, a new student with a blank name tag walks toward the school gate.*

day5_ending_complicit_13.text: *Only the hair color is different. The hand habit of holding the bag strap is the same.*

day5_ending_complicit_15.text: *The new student nods without a word. The fingers around the bag strap curl three times.*

day5_ending_complicit_16.text: Don't worry. Everyone will take good care of you.

day5_ending_complicit_17.text: *Ms. Eunsu watches from behind. At the end of the hallway, Seolhwa stands without a word.*

day5_xover_server_1.text: *Connected to the institute's server. A file directory appears on the old monitor.*

day5_xover_server_preview_choice.text: There were three sets of records with different dates left on the server.
choices: cycle_01.zip — Cycle 1: Ideal Environment Plans (PROJECT CUPID)
cycle_07.log — Cycle 7: Lee Seolhwa and the Emergency Exit
cycle_12.log — Cycle 12: Darkroom and Subject #12 Disposal Log

day5_xover_preview_2.text: *Spring breeze. New uniform. First day of transfer.*

day5_xover_preview_3.text: *Cherry petals repeat from the same position. Only the wind direction changes.*

day5_xover_preview_4.text: *Bottom right of the screen, in small text: cycle_01*

day5_xover_preview_heroine.text:
*[CUPID_ENV_PREVIEW]*
*Emotional imprint model: {cupid_heroine}*
*Compliance response rate: {cupid_compliance}*
*Pre-dose environment response test matches M-13 stabilization index.*

day5_observer_1.text: *The credits ended. The screen goes dark. Blackout.*

day5_observer_3.text: *Text appears one character at a time in the center of the screen.*

day5_observer_4.text:
EDINA FOUNDATION / NEVERGRAD RESEARCH INSTITUTE
Security audit: external review session
Reference file: #13 observation record

day5_observer_5.text:
Access scope: audit / monitoring
Session status: connected
Subject contact authorization: none

day5_observer_7.text:
Contact record comparison complete
Comparing behavioral patterns

day5_observer_8.text:
Reference: research director Park Eunsu / 13 observations
External review session: #13 ({name}) / {play_time}

Shared fields: continued access after warning; accumulated interventions
Similarity: persistent observation pattern matches

Automated decision: pending

day5_observer_cupid_extra.text:
Cross-reference:

CUPID_ENV_PREVIEW detected.
Emotional imprint: {cupid_heroine}
Compliance rate: {cupid_compliance}
Partially matches M-13 stabilization indicators.

Notes:
Observer data is still bound to the #13 file.

day5_observer_10.text: *And at the bottom, in very small text:*

day5_ending_true_16_clear_intro.text: *As Seolhwa opened her mouth, the muffled static faded away. The voice that had called out from behind the seventh stairwell reached me clearly.*

day5_ending_true_16_clear.text: That’s the first time you’ve called me that.

day5_ending_true_27_riin.text: *Additional materials appeared below the article. Ms. Riin, who had escaped with us, submitted six cycles of actual medication comparison logs and original charts.*

day5_ending_true_27_riin_2.text: *Headquarters approval numbers remained beside every dosing date. An early statement trying to frame the case as the lead researcher’s personal misconduct was taken down after half a day.*

day5_ending_true_27_sea.text: *Sea received outside protective custody after leaving the facility with us. A few days later, we walked side by side down a daytime shopping street far from school. In her hands, there was neither an attendance book nor the student council room key.*

day5_ending_true_27_sea_2.text: I don’t have to wear an armband or follow anyone anymore. Shall we try that street over there too?

day5_ending_true_30_memory.text: *Every last word we had exchanged behind the old building’s stairs came back to me as well. Beside her name, I added one more line: “Next time, let’s meet outside instead of here.”*

day5_ending_escape_riin.text: *Ms. Riin, who had come out with us, relocated to evade the foundation’s pursuit. Before leaving, she sent a brief message saying the original charts hidden beneath the infirmary floor had already been seized.*

day5_ending_escape_sea.text: *Sea, who had escaped with us, moved to an external protective shelter far from school. Attached below her brief message saying she had arrived was a single photo of a paper bag from a neighborhood bakery.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_1.text: After the first week, I had to tear up the classroom calendar. Sea only cut off the corner without turning over a new page.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_2.text: Don't worry about the calendar. The one outside is wrong too.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_3.text: Leaves grew on the tree beyond the window. Cherry blossoms tied with wire continued to hang on the classroom window.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_4.text: Dust accumulated on the tips of the paper petals. When I stretched out my hand, Sea handed me a wet towel first.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_5.text: I'll clean it. You might hurt your hand.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_6.text: When I opened the lunch box lid, there was an egg roll that was the same cooked and cut thickness as yesterday.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_7.text: On days when I didn't pick up chopsticks, Sea didn't eat either, so the two lunch boxes remained closed until evening.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_8.text: Just eat one piece. I won't ask after that.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_9.text: After eating one piece, Sea raised his chopsticks. The same request came back the next day.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_10.text: My notebooks were piled up in a drawer at the back of the classroom. I wrote the date on each first page, but from one day I started writing only the weather.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_11.text: Even on a rainy day, the flowers by the window did not get wet. Only the scent sprayed by Sea became a little stronger.

day5_ending_cage_sea_epilogue_12.text: When the graduation ceremony practice broadcast was heard from the playground outside, Sea got up to close the window.

day5_ending_cage_sea_inside_choice.text: Sea put his hand on the window handle. My tie wasn't on yet.

day5_ending_cage_sea_window_1.text: New students lined up on the playground. There was an empty seat at the end of the line moving towards the school gate.

day5_ending_cage_sea_window_2.text: Sea standing next to me looked at the face reflected in the window but did not look outside.

day5_ending_cage_sea_window_3.text: Your place is here. I didn't even put your name on their list.

day5_ending_cage_sea_window_4.text: The bus door closed behind the glass. I put my palm on the window and watched the bus turn around.

day5_ending_cage_sea_window_5.text: Sea took my tie and waited for me to turn around before wrapping it around his hand and tying the knot.

day5_ending_cage_sea_hand_1.text: Sea My hands were colder than the window handle. As soon as I caught it, the fingers came between my hands.

day5_ending_cage_sea_hand_3.text: I nodded without looking at the window. The outside broadcast faded away behind a sheet of glass.

day5_ending_cage_sea_hand_4.text: Sea put my hand in his pocket. To let go, you first had to straighten your fingers one by one.

day5_ending_cage_sea_hand_5.text: One hand remained in his pocket while he took out his tie. Sea made a knot with his other hand.

day5_ending_cage_sea_close_1.text: You can sleep in late tomorrow too. I'll be there first.

day5_ending_cage_sea_close_2.text: The numbers cut out from the calendar were piled up in the trash can. Sea closed the lunch box lid and shook off the dust from the flower petals.

day5_ending_cage_sea_close_3.text: The classroom lights went off. The doorknob in the hallway didn't move and only the chair inside scratched the floor.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_1.text: The teacher took out a stamp from the drawer of the teacher's desk, opened the lid, and pressed it into the thirteenth slot of the attendance register.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_2.text: I read the text that was pressed so hard that the paper burned. It said deferred graduation, and in the small bracket below it said permanent.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_3.text: This is not sent to the board of directors. This is the ledger I keep here.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_4.text: The teacher closed the dojo and took off his glasses and placed them next to the dojo.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_5.text: A cleaning cart passed by in the hallway. The teacher returned only after checking the lock on the inside of the door.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_6.text: I reported you as disposed of. No one will come looking for you.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_8.text: I kept your name. I don't need to erase the name I'll call you by.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_9.text: A silver band was placed on the table. The teacher opened his palm to ask for his wrist.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_10.text: I didn't take my hands out of my pockets. The teacher pulled an empty chair instead of my hand.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_11.text: Sit down. Your legs will ache if you stand there waiting.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_12.text: When I sat down on the chair, my wrists were at the same height as the lectern. There was a thin cushioning material attached to the inside of the band.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_13.text: The teacher wiped my wrist with a cloth. There was a small metallic sound as the buckle closed.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_14.text: Tell me if it's too tight. I can loosen that.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_15.text: A finger slipped under the buckle. The teacher noticed the gap and lowered my sleeve.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_16.text: The setting sun shone long through the window. Other spaces in the attendance register had already been erased with black lines.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_17.text: Next to my compartment was my teacher's name. The printed word “person in charge” was underlined twice with a ruler.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_18.text: We'll be calling roll here tomorrow too. Just answer me.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_20.text: They're in other classrooms. They won't be coming into this one.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_21.text: I could see empty desks through the glasses on the teacher's table. The teacher put two of them on the window.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_22.text: My book and your book faced the same side. I sat down with the door behind me.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_23.text: If you want to change seats, let me know. The window is okay, and the one right in front of the lectern is also okay.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_24.text: The wristband made a sound every time it touched the desk. The teacher folded a small piece of cloth there.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_25.text: As the final bell rang outside, the teacher opened the attendance sheet and put pen to the thirteenth row.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_26.text: My name was called. While he didn't answer, the tip of his pen stayed on the paper.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_epilogue_27.text: The teacher did not urge. I turned the seal lid on the table straight with my fingertips.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_1.text: The first bus departed from the back of the terminal. Yuna put the camera inside the court while buying tickets.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_2.text: As I sat down, water dripped from my wet shoes. Both of them stayed for a while without their feet on the floor.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_3.text: The driver didn't ask the name of the school or our names as he took the tickets.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_4.text: As the bus went down the mountain road, the cell phone signal returned. Yuna covered the turning screen with his palm.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_5.text: Don't open the app. Don't even turn it off now.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_6.text: I didn't get off at the first terminal. We remained in the car until people changed and more empty seats became available.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_7.text: Next to the second stop was a small lodging establishment. I went in the direction where the sign light was off.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_8.text: The counter staff asked for my ID. The hand that looked up my number stopped twice.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_9.text: They said there was no registered information. Yuna's student ID card came out as already expired.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_10.text: The employee held out a piece of paper for me to re-enter. Yuna grabbed my arm while I was writing down the same number.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_11.text: Let's just leave. We'll find somewhere else.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_12.text: I tore the paper outside the door, folded the part with my name on it small, and put it in my pocket.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_13.text: We rented a rooftop room behind the station. The landlord only told me the price of the room and how to turn on the boiler.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_14.text: As I hung my school uniform on the clothesline, water droplets fell into the bucket. Yuna hung my sleeve away from his clothes.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_15.text: Evidence from the school was insufficient. You couldn't come looking for someone just by looking at the date in the photo.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_16.text: I wrote down the number I wanted to call and erased it. No matter who I explained to, they would check my name first.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_17.text: Let's eat first. Anything that can wait until tomorrow can wait.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_18.text: Two triangle kimbap came out of a convenience store bag. The rice was cold because I had been standing there for a long time picking it.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_19.text: Yuna opened the envelope until I chose first. I didn't say it was okay either way.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_20.text: I folded up the empty wrapping paper, threw it away, and opened the window. Instead of the school announcement, the sound of dishes was heard from the house across the street.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_21.text: Yuna checked the number of films remaining in the camera and found that he could still take two pictures.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_22.text: There wasn't a single photo taken anywhere other than school.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_23.text: I stood by the window and looked into the lens without waiting for Yuna to tell me where to look.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_24.text: Yuna held the camera and waited for my answer.
choices: Tell Yuna to take the picture first

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_25.text: Stay just like that. You're all in the frame.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_26.text: A second shutter sound briefly rang out in the room. Yuna smiled for the first time while looking at the camera.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_27.text: I decided on a name to write on the back of the photo. I wrote mine, and Yuna chose Yuna.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_28.text: I was awkward with the new name, so I called it twice. Yuna couldn't hear it the first time and looked back the second time.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_29.text: It was a piece of paper without a space for resident registration or school records. Only the two names and today's date were placed side by side.

day5_ending_escape_epilogue_30.text: I went down to find a place to leave the film. Yuna locked the door and handed the key into my hand.

day5_ending_escape_riin_after_1.text: There was an envelope of cash stuck in the bottom of the bag. When I took out the towel given to me in the health room, an envelope came out with it.

day5_ending_escape_riin_after_2.text: Inside were folded bills and a copy of a prescription. Next to the name of the drug, there was a sign saying “stop taking it.”

day5_ending_escape_riin_after_3.text: There was no signature of Riin. Instead, the address of a nearby emergency room was written on the end of the paper.

day5_ending_escape_riin_after_4.text: There were thirteen lines containing the medication administration date. In the last line, today's time is written in minutes.

day5_ending_escape_riin_after_5.text: Yuna read the paper and looked at my arm. I lowered my sleeves to cover the injection marks.

day5_ending_escape_riin_after_6.text: Inside the envelope, there was another short note telling people not to throw away the medicine envelope.

day5_ending_escape_riin_after_7.text: I put the paper to show first at the hospital first. I divided the cash in half with Yuna and put it in different pockets.

day5_ending_escape_riin_after_8.text: Instead of contacting Riin, he closed the bag, leaving only a handprint on the corner of the paper.

day5_ending_escape_riin_after_9.text: The towels we were told to use while waiting were laid out on the bus seats. Water no longer dripped from wet clothes.

day5_ending_escape_sea_after_1.text: Sea's voice came from the radio. I called the number of the hallway opposite to where our footsteps were coming from.

day5_ending_escape_sea_after_2.text: I saw them. They went upstairs. I'll follow them.

day5_ending_escape_sea_after_3.text: Yuna pulled my arm and pushed it into his bag without turning down the sound of the radio.

day5_ending_escape_sea_after_4.text: The sound of running footsteps became distant. Sea opened the door on the other side, continuing to tell me to follow him.

day5_ending_escape_sea_after_5.text: I didn't stop walking. When I turned around, I felt like I would make eye contact with Sea before the door closed.

day5_ending_escape_sea_after_6.text: There was no name on the last radio. The only thing I heard was a brief message telling me to hurry up because the door was open.

day5_ending_escape_sea_after_7.text: The emergency exit handle in front of us was down. The little rubber wedge on the door held on until the end.

day5_ending_escape_sea_after_8.text: After going outside, I removed the wedge. The pink rubber band that Sea used on the lunch box lid was wrapped around it.

day5_ending_escape_sea_after_9.text: I put the wedge in my pocket, put the radio down outside the rain puddle, and followed Yuna.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_1.text: The first truck was dispatched along the national highway. The teacher said he wasn't ready yet and put the briefcase on his lap.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_2.text: As the corners of the paper got wet and stuck together, the teacher used his fingernail to tear off each sheet and put them in an empty bag.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_3.text: Don't mix up the originals and the copies. Keep the pages with my signature at the front.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_4.text: I moved to my seat under the roof of the bus stop. When the teacher took off his glasses, rainwater pooled around his eyes.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_6.text: The teacher wiped his hand with his sleeve and then lowered his hand. I turned my face away to avoid dripping water on the wet paper.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_7.text: It was the third cycle. You asked me if I'd eaten.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_8.text: It was something I couldn't remember. When the teacher saw me, he shook his head saying he didn't know.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_9.text: I know. You don't remember. I was the only one who kept those words.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_10.text: The teacher's hands were shaking on the bag. I grabbed the documents instead and sat down with my palms on the floor.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_11.text: So I wanted to see you the next day too. Next semester and the next too.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_12.text: Is that why you kept it going?

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_13.text: The teacher could not answer, but lowered his head and folded and unfolded the temples of his glasses.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_14.text: That shouldn't have been the reason. Those were words I couldn't include in the report I was writing.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_15.text: I didn't write that sentence for you. He pointed to the space to sign next to the teacher's name.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_16.text: This time I'll write down everything I did. You don't have to leave anything out for my sake.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_17.text: The teacher placed the paper on a cold bus stop chair and wrote his name on the first line.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_18.text: He turned the paper and held it out so that I could read it without covering the erase marks.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_19.text: A bus came from afar. The teacher woke up only then, but made way for me to get on first.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_20.text: I carried my briefcase and climbed the stairs. The teacher followed after confirming the destination with the driver.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_21.text: We didn't sit next to each other. I heard the same stop announcement across the hallway.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_22.text: The teacher took out his cell phone from his bag, turned off the phone call coming into the school, and dialed the report number directly.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_23.text: When the call was connected, he said he was the head of research. The word homeroom teacher was added at the end.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_24.text: I looked out the window and opened my left hand. The imprint of the paper bag handle remained on my palm.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_25.text: Even as the bus left the mountain, the teacher did not hang up the phone and was still giving his address.

day5_ending_resist_epilogue_26.text: The name of the next stop was a name I had never heard before. I listened to the announcement until the end.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_1.text: I didn't know when I put the bus ticket in my new school uniform pocket, so I checked the date.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_2.text: It was today's date. I opened the crumpled ticket and entered the school gate.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_3.text: A student waved under the cherry blossoms and walked straight toward me. It was my first time seeing this face.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_4.text: Your first day? Let's walk to class together. I'm going that way too.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_5.text: The student's hand stretched out to the left and his palm was held in his pocket. The fingernail marks were quickly erased.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_6.text: He complained that his shoelaces were untied and stopped. Sea waited in front of me and looked at the string on the same side.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_7.text: There was a student with a camera at the hallway window. As I passed, he closed the lens cap.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_8.text: You can take pictures later. Even if you don’t take a picture now.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_9.text: I laughed and said I never asked for it. The student lowered the camera and turned his head first.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_10.text: A teacher came out in front of the health room. He was holding a cup, but when he saw my face, he lowered his hand.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_11.text: Have you eaten breakfast? If you haven't eaten, start with water, not tea.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_12.text: I answered okay and walked. For a moment, I had the taste of tea that I had not yet drunk in my mouth.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_13.text: The homeroom teacher at the door opened the attendance sheet and pointed to my seat before asking my name.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_14.text: Third desk by the window. You can put your bag inside it.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_15.text: As I fumbled around the inside of the desk, a fine line caught on my fingertips. I touched it again with my left hand and found the shape.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_16.text: Run away. My finger moved along the three letters. I took out my hand and dusted it off.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_18.text: Someone behind me pulled a chair. When I turned around, there was an empty desk against the wall.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_19.text: Sea handed over a new ballpoint pen. Before I even opened the package, my thumb went into the groove of the rubber grip.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_20.text: I changed hands and wrote my name in the notebook. There was some eraser powder left, so I swept it away with my palm.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_21.text: The classroom clock moved one step. While the teacher took attendance, I wrote the date on the first page.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_22.text: The end of the number bounced upwards. The tip of the teacher's pen also stopped for a moment in the same spot.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_23.text: Petals fell from the tree outside the window. It didn't reach my desk, but I closed the book with my hand.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_24.text: That behavior was so funny that I laughed alone, and Sea laughed along with me and opened the textbook.

day5_ending_forget_epilogue_25.text: There was still dust in the groove under the desk. Only the tip of the fingernail on my left hand was not removed until the break.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_1.text: Two handprints were left on the emergency staircase railing. There was no moisture on the side Seolhwa grabbed.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_2.text: Go down. Watch your feet. That last step is narrow.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_3.text: As I put my foot down and looked back, I saw that the tips of Seolhwa's shoes slightly overlapped the edge of the stairs.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_5.text: As Seolhwa came down a flight of stairs, the paint color in the background was reflected from the fingertips holding the railing.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_6.text: I can't go any farther. I knew when you opened the door.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_7.text: When I stretched out my hand, Seolhwa did not avoid it. I tried to put my fingers together, but all I could do was the cold metal of the railing.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_8.text: Don't tell me it's all right. It's not something you should have to be all right with.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_9.text: I closed my mouth and opened my left hand, and Seolhwa looked down at the lines on my palm all the way.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_10.text: This time I gave you the push. Out there, walk on your own feet.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_11.text: A wind came up from under the stairs. The tips of Seolhwa's hair brightened and then disappeared behind the railing.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_13.text: Write it down. You've tried remembering enough times already.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_14.text: Seolhwa laughed. I began to see the white wall next to the door before my face.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_15.text: I didn't lower my head because I thought that if I closed my eyes, I would remember my last expression incorrectly again.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_16.text: When I came out of the emergency exit, the floor was wet in the early morning. My shadow continued all the way to the bottom of the stairs.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_17.text: I walked until the first store opened. The owner gave me a chair, but I bought a notebook first.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_18.text: As I flipped through the cover with my left hand, the new paper stuck to my palm, so I took another page off.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_19.text: Lee Seolhwa. The pen stopped twice as I wrote the three Korean characters.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_20.text: On the next line, I wrote the number seven, and below that I shared what I saw and heard.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_21.text: I did not move the pen to my right hand. Even though my wrist was stiff and the writing was slanted, I kept it as is.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_22.text: When the bus stopped outside the store and I heard the door open, I closed my notebook.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_23.text: I asked the driver the destination. I didn't understand so I asked one more time before buying the ticket.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_24.text: As I sat down and opened the window a little, the sound of the wind entered my left ear.

day5_ending_ghost_epilogue_25.text: This time there were no other voices mixed in. I put my hand in the pocket containing the note.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_1.text: When I lifted the pen from the signature pad, a new card appeared. Under the photo, the words Deputy Director and #13 were written.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_2.text: Wear it around your neck on the stairs. The doors need to read where the card is before they'll open.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_3.text: The teacher adjusted the length of the line. Unlike the wrist band, I could take the card off on my own.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_4.text: When the control room door opened, the monitors on the wall turned on at once, illuminating the classroom, hallway, and health room.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_5.text: Yuna looked up from the basement screen. Eyes turned to me, searching for the camera.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_6.text: Sea was closing the lid of his lunch box in the classroom. I covered the compartment containing the remaining side dishes with my hand.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_7.text: Riin, who was sitting in front of an empty tray in the health room, took his hand out of his gown pocket when the camera started rolling.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_8.text: You can also hear sounds here. Use this button to turn it on.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_9.text: When I pressed the button, the sound of chair legs came out of the speaker. Yuna moved off the screen.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_10.text: The teacher put his hand on my shoulder. My face at the edge of the monitor was at the same angle as the new card photo.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_11.text: We'll check the next schedule together. You have an approval field on your side now too.

day5_ending_complicit_epilogue_12.text: The medication schedule was opened. The name of the last approver was still blank.

day5_ending_complicit_control_choice.text: There was an OK button below the density adjustment bar. My card was inserted into the reader.

day5_ending_complicit_low_1.text: Move the bar to the left. Although the dosage was reduced, the number of people scheduled to be administered did not change.

day5_ending_complicit_low_2.text: Write down why you reduced it too. So the next person doesn't increase it again.

day5_ending_complicit_low_3.text: When I wrote in the reason box that it was to reduce damage, the teacher read the sentence and pressed save.

day5_ending_complicit_low_4.text: New instructions appeared on the health room screen. Riin read the paper and then looked at the camera.

day5_ending_complicit_low_5.text: I turned off the sound. My name was still on the first line of the approval record.

day5_ending_complicit_same_1.text: It was approved without changing the numbers. The amount used yesterday went over today as well.

day5_ending_complicit_same_2.text: Keeping it the same is simplest. Change it and there's more to explain.

day5_ending_complicit_same_3.text: The teacher displayed today's schedule on the monitor next to me. Another student's name was entered in the blank space.

day5_ending_complicit_same_4.text: Riin from the health room selected three ampoules. I just checked that the numbers were correct.

day5_ending_complicit_same_5.text: My hand stopped while I was trying to turn the paper. The page you just approved has already been changed to read-only.

day5_ending_complicit_high_1.text: Moving the bar to the right increased the estimated recovery time and added a warning sign.

day5_ending_complicit_high_2.text: The teacher didn't stop my hand. It just said that if the reason box is left blank, it cannot be saved.

day5_ending_complicit_high_3.text: It was written that it reduces memory retention. This was an expression I read in my previous report.

day5_ending_complicit_high_4.text: On the health room screen, Riin shook his head. When I turned on the sound, the words “no” came out briefly.

day5_ending_complicit_high_5.text: When I pressed the OK button, Riin's voice cut off and the next schedule covered the screen.

day5_ending_complicit_close_1.text: The approval document was printed. The teacher checked my signature space and pulled an empty chair aside.

day5_ending_complicit_close_2.text: Good work. You can read the next report first.

day5_ending_complicit_close_3.text: The second hand of the wall clock and the clock on the screen moved together one step at a time. I only saw that the two clocks were out of sync.

day5_ending_complicit_close_4.text: As I hung the new card around my neck, the line shown on the monitor came down parallel to my tie.

day5_ending_complicit_close_5.text: Yuna spoke at the bottom of the screen. I pressed the next camera without turning up the volume.

day5_archive_cycle07_1.text: The first page of the record had the name Kim Taeho. The left eyebrow in the face photo was the same as mine now.

day5_archive_cycle07_2.text: The 7th cycle sign appeared at the bottom of the restored recording screen. Inside, I was holding the bag strap with my left hand.

day5_archive_cycle07_3.text: Seolhwa was alive. Every time I passed through the hallway, the silver of my hair moved on my shoulders.

day5_archive_cycle07_4.text: Taeho. Come in before the door closes. The hinges here are loud.

day5_archive_cycle07_5.text: When I held the data room door, Seolhwa went inside first. I took off my shoes and silenced the sound of my footsteps.

day5_archive_cycle07_6.text: There was one window high up. Rainwater hit the screen and the paper smelled wet.

day5_archive_cycle07_7.text: I put a folded towel on the doorknob. Seolhwa took out a small flashlight from his pocket.

day5_archive_cycle07_8.text: Start with the record drawers on the left. The right side has this semester's attendance books.

day5_archive_cycle07_10.text: I saw them while cleaning yesterday. Today's the first time I've read them.

day5_archive_cycle07_11.text: I pulled the metal drawer from the bottom of the bookshelf, but a wad of paper got caught and it wouldn't open all the way.

day5_archive_cycle07_12.text: Seolhwa put the flashlight in his mouth and pressed down on the paper. I lifted the drawer slightly with both hands.

day5_archive_cycle07_13.text: The top envelope had the word input stamped on it. It wasn't something to use in school documents.

day5_archive_cycle07_14.text: When I took out the photo, my face appeared. The name was not Kim Taeho and the date of admission was different.

day5_archive_cycle07_15.text: The next envelope also had the same face. This time his hair was short and his license plate was resting on his shoulder.

day5_archive_cycle07_16.text: When Seolhwa put down the flashlight, the light headed towards the ceiling and the two's long shadows clung to the wall.

day5_archive_cycle07_17.text: I hope it was made as a joke. But there is too much paper.

day5_archive_cycle07_18.text: Six photos were placed side by side. Only the last space was empty. My current name was written next to it.

day5_archive_cycle07_20.text: Instead of answering, Seolhwa flipped the current envelope over. This week's date was written on the back.

day5_archive_cycle07_21.text: Memory check, adaptation observation, reinsertion. Each item was signed and dated without interruption.

day5_archive_cycle07_22.text: I closed my mouth while trying to talk about my memories of changing schools. I couldn't remember where I got on the bus.

day5_archive_cycle07_23.text: Seolhwa took out my notebook, opened the front page, and put a small question mark next to the address I wrote down.

day5_archive_cycle07_24.text: Don't make up answers now. Only tell me what you remember.

day5_archive_cycle07_25.text: I didn't finish reading the address. Seolhwa returned the notebook without deleting the question mark.

day5_archive_cycle07_26.text: The hallway speakers turned on. The towel in front of the data room door moved in a small breeze.

day5_archive_cycle07_27.text: This is a regular inspection of the old building. Remaining students should go to the main building.

day5_archive_cycle07_28.text: Seolhwa looked at his watch. It was twenty minutes earlier than the original inspection time.

day5_archive_cycle07_29.text: I put two envelopes in my bag. I tried to take the rest with my cell phone, but turned down the screen brightness.

day5_archive_cycle07_30.text: Turn it on once we're outside. They'll see the light if you use it here.

day5_archive_cycle07_31.text: Seolhwa put a photo in the inside pocket of his school uniform. It was on the other side from my bag.

day5_archive_cycle07_32.text: When I opened the door a little, I saw a red light at the end of the hallway. It was a light that did not turn on during the day.

day5_archive_cycle07_33.text: We went down the stairs with our shoes in our hands. Instead of a school guide, there were plumbing numbers on the wall.

day5_archive_cycle07_34.text: There was an emergency exit sign on the downstairs door. Seolhwa turned off the flashlight and placed his hand on the handle.

day5_archive_cycle07_35.text: The door wasn't locked. Rainwater from outside spilled over the threshold and flowed inside.

day5_archive_cycle07_36.text: If I leave here, am I outside the fence?

day5_archive_cycle07_37.text: Behind the parking lot. People can pass between the fences. I saw it during the day.

day5_archive_cycle07_38.text: I grabbed the bag strap again and covered the front of my uniform to keep the paper from getting wet.

day5_archive_cycle07_39.text: Seolhwa put his foot out first, then lifted his toe for a moment as the rainwater reached his socks.

day5_archive_cycle07_40.text: The door crashed behind us and Seolhwa caught the handle before it hit the wall.

day5_archive_cycle07_42.text: The teacher was standing on the stairs. The two men in the back were holding flashlights at face level.

day5_archive_cycle07_43.text: Seolhwa blocked my path. The hand holding my bag slowly came down.

day5_archive_cycle07_44.text: I'm the one who opened the records room. He only followed me.

day5_archive_cycle07_45.text: Put down your bag first. There is no need for either of you to get hurt.

day5_archive_cycle07_46.text: The man behind the teacher stepped on a puddle while going down one step, and his black pants got wet.

day5_archive_cycle07_47.text: Seolhwa opened the door again and pushed the door panel with his body, widening the passage behind me.

day5_archive_cycle07_48.text: You too, come out. We can go out together.

day5_archive_cycle07_49.text: Seolhwa grabbed my left hand. The right hand holding the photo envelope was not touched.

day5_archive_cycle07_51.text: When he opened his palm, Seolhwa drew a short stroke with the tip of his fingernail. I closed my hands and opened them again.

day5_archive_cycle07_52.text: Even if you move your right hand as they tell you, make sure your left hand remembers.

day5_archive_cycle07_53.text: Rainwater flowed between my fingers. Seolhwa's fingernail pressed the same spot once more.

day5_archive_cycle07_54.text: Will it stay in my memory if it hurts?

day5_archive_cycle07_55.text: I don't know. But it's your hand. You'll have it longer than that paper.

day5_archive_cycle07_56.text: The sound of footsteps on the stairs became faster. Seolhwa pushed me out the door without letting go of my hand.

day5_archive_cycle07_57.text: Get out next time. Even if your name changes, look at this hand first.

day5_archive_cycle07_58.text: The teacher’s hand came through the crack in the door. Seolhwa held the door handle with both hands.

day5_archive_cycle07_59.text: I left my bag outside the door. One of Seolhwa's shoes was caught on the threshold.

day5_archive_cycle07_60.text: The door did not close completely. The man came around to the side and grabbed my arm.

day5_archive_cycle07_61.text: The bag strap slipped off my shoulder. The wet bag fell to the floor and absorbed the water.

day5_archive_cycle07_62.text: Seolhwa called my name. One time it was Taeho and the next time the end of the horse got caught in the door.

day5_archive_cycle07_63.text: The teacher picked up the bag. I tried to take the document out of his hand and put my left hand on the wall.

day5_archive_cycle07_64.text: When the stroke of the palm touched the concrete, the fingers folded in the direction drawn by Seolhwa.

day5_archive_cycle07_65.text: What about Seolhwa? She's coming with us, isn't she?

day5_archive_cycle07_66.text: No one answered. Seolhwa's shoes disappeared inside the door and my arm was pulled to the other side.

day5_archive_cycle07_67.text: The sound on the recording screen was cut off. The door closing under the emergency lights was repeated twice.

day5_archive_cycle07_68.text: The next page listed Lee Seolhwa as an additional person. The outcome was permanent disposal.

day5_archive_cycle07_69.text: The subject's compartment was marked as 8th re-entry. A new name tag was attached above the name Kim Taeho.

day5_archive_cycle07_70.text: I let go of the restore screen. My left hand was actually holding the edge of the server desk.

day5_archive_cycle07_71.text: Before closing the record, I saved Seolhwa's photo separately. The stamp indicating disposal was moved to a different line from the name.

day5_archive_cycle07_72.text: In the photo, Seolhwa was still holding the flashlight. It wasn't a photo that asked people to close their eyes or smile.

day5_archive_cycle07_73.text: The words left at the door remained at the end of the recording. The sound of rain continued for a long time after the last word.

day5_archive_cycle07_74.text: I stretched out my left hand and pressed my finger where the stroke had been. I wiped my hands before turning the screen.

day5_archive_cycle07_75.text: Even when I went back to the original list on the server, the capacity number next to the seventh record was the same as before I read it.

day5_archive_cycle12_1.text: The next folder bore the name Lee Junho. Choi Yuna had also signed the photography club application.

day5_archive_cycle12_2.text: On the restoration screen, I was adjusting my camera strap. Yuna waved an empty film canister next to him.

day5_archive_cycle12_3.text: Sunbae. Let's photograph somewhere besides the schoolyard today. We always go to the same spot.

day5_archive_cycle12_4.text: If you take a picture from the same place, you can see the changes.

day5_archive_cycle12_5.text: Yuna pointed to my camera and said that the date function was broken and I had to write it down myself.

day5_archive_cycle12_6.text: We wrote the date on the back of the developed photo. It was the same day, but one number I wrote was different.

day5_archive_cycle12_7.text: That's yesterday's date. You're a day behind again, sunbae.

day5_archive_cycle12_8.text: I laughed and erased it. The rubber eraser has worn black over the pencil marks.

day5_archive_cycle12_9.text: The lockers in the photography department were old and the plywood underneath was cracked. Every time Yuna put the camera in, it rattled.

day5_archive_cycle12_10.text: I folded the paper under the plywood and Yuna nodded as the floor was secured.

day5_archive_cycle12_11.text: It's steady now. You're good at this sort of thing, sunbae.

day5_archive_cycle12_12.text: I tried putting an empty film canister inside it. When the floor was covered, there was no sound from inside.

day5_archive_cycle12_13.text: A photo taken a few days later showed an unfamiliar student. I turned it over and found an old date and my handwriting.

day5_archive_cycle12_14.text: At first, I thought it was a photo left by a former member of the department. The same wrist was shown in the second photo.

day5_archive_cycle12_15.text: Yuna pointed his finger at my wrist. The watch buckle mark remained in the same place as in the photo.

day5_archive_cycle12_16.text: Is that you in the photo, sunbae?

day5_archive_cycle12_17.text: I put the photo on the desk. I knew that if I said no, Yuna would take out the next photo.

day5_archive_cycle12_18.text: I found envelopes numbered from first to eleven in the drawer. The names were all different, but the signatures were similar.

day5_archive_cycle12_19.text: There was no photo in the last envelope. Only my name, Lee Junho, was written on the medication confirmation form.

day5_archive_cycle12_20.text: Yuna locked the door, turned on the dark room light, and read the dates one by one under the red light.

day5_archive_cycle12_21.text: We wrote down what we remembered on separate pieces of paper and then folded and changed the pieces of paper before speaking to each other.

day5_archive_cycle12_22.text: The name of my former school that I remember wasn't on the map. Yuna also took a photo of the map search screen.

day5_archive_cycle12_23.text: Keep the questions we can't answer too. Don't erase them.

day5_archive_cycle12_24.text: An announcement was made in the classroom telling students to come to the health room. The student's name was not mentioned until the end.

day5_archive_cycle12_25.text: The same notice popped up on my phone. A sentence was attached saying that today's schedule cannot be changed.

day5_archive_cycle12_26.text: At the door of the health room, I left my bag with Yuna. Yuna hung it on her shoulder without loosening the strap.

day5_archive_cycle12_27.text: If ten minutes pass and you don't come out, I'll go in.

day5_archive_cycle12_28.text: Don't wait at the door. Wait in the photography club room.

day5_archive_cycle12_29.text: Riin closed the curtain when I came in. The door side was covered, not the bed side.

day5_archive_cycle12_30.text: Did you drink water today? Did you eat?

day5_archive_cycle12_31.text: I answered the questions in order. The teacher just looked at the clock without writing down the answer.

day5_archive_cycle12_32.text: One ampoule in the tray was less full than the others. Riin held the ampoule in his palm.

day5_archive_cycle12_33.text: Will that injection erase my memory?

day5_archive_cycle12_34.text: Riin's hand stopped. The sound of putting down the ampoule was louder than usual.

day5_archive_cycle12_36.text: It's written in the papers. Your signature's there too.

day5_archive_cycle12_37.text: Riin first checked to see who was outside by lifting and closing the curtain at the door.

day5_archive_cycle12_38.text: If you walk later, keep a hand on the wall. Don't run.

day5_archive_cycle12_39.text: The area where the injection needle touched was hidden on the screen. Only the sound of my breathing was left in the recorded audio.

day5_archive_cycle12_40.text: When I left the health room, the hallways seemed double-layered. I placed my palm on the tiles on the wall.

day5_archive_cycle12_41.text: Yuna came out from around the corner. My shirt got caught in my hand holding the bag strap.

day5_archive_cycle12_42.text: Ten minutes have passed. Let’s go to the photography club together.

day5_archive_cycle12_43.text: Yuna, who was standing on the side where I was leaning against the wall, shortened his stride without pulling my arm.

day5_archive_cycle12_44.text: When I entered the dark room, a red light came on. Yuna put down his bag and put a chair in front of the door.

day5_archive_cycle12_46.text: Don’t say things like that when you can’t walk alone right now.

day5_archive_cycle12_47.text: I took out the envelopes from my bag. My fingertips lost their strength and the first photo fell to the floor.

day5_archive_cycle12_48.text: Yuna picked it up and put it in order. When I asked him to hold the corner, he pressed it with both hands.

day5_archive_cycle12_49.text: As I pulled out the film and held it up to the window light, I realized too late that it was a dark room. Yuna put my hand down.

day5_archive_cycle12_50.text: It's already developed. You don't need to hold it up to the light now.

day5_archive_cycle12_51.text: Remember the bottom of the locker? Where we put the paper.

day5_archive_cycle12_52.text: Yuna nodded and took the camera from my hand and placed it on his chest.

day5_archive_cycle12_53.text: I put a photo and a film into the empty container. I had to change hands three times to close the lid.

day5_archive_cycle12_54.text: Put it under it. If I ask for it tomorrow, don’t give it to me right away.

day5_archive_cycle12_55.text: But if you ask for it, why shouldn't I give it to you?

day5_archive_cycle12_56.text: While writing my name on paper, the last letter overlapped twice.

day5_archive_cycle12_57.text: The person who comes through the school gates tomorrow may not know this name.

day5_archive_cycle12_58.text: Yuna took the paper. The date was rewritten under three letters Lee Junho.

day5_archive_cycle12_59.text: Then I'll ask you. To make sure you're really my sunbae.

day5_archive_cycle12_60.text: Don't throw it away if I get the answer wrong. Keep it for the thirteenth one too.

day5_archive_cycle12_61.text: Yuna's hand wrapped around the film canister. Instead of wiping my eyes, I closed the camera strap shorter.

day5_archive_cycle12_62.text: Even if I come through the school gates again tomorrow morning, I won't be the Lee Junho you know.

day5_archive_cycle12_63.text: Yuna pressed his lips. He didn't answer and just shook his head once.

day5_archive_cycle12_64.text: Please don't give up on the thirteenth me. If I don't know, tell me again.

day5_archive_cycle12_65.text: When I heard the sound of shoes outside, I tried to move the chair in front of the door and lost the backrest.

day5_archive_cycle12_66.text: Yuna took the chair, silently moved it to the side, and grabbed my bag again before opening the door.

day5_archive_cycle12_67.text: Sunbae. What's my name? You can still tell me, can't you?

day5_archive_cycle12_68.text: Choi Yuna. You hate losing photos more than anything.

day5_archive_cycle12_69.text: Yuna lowered his head. I opened the door a little and untied the bag strap from Yuna's hand.

day5_archive_cycle12_70.text: Teacher Eunsu was standing in the hallway. When he saw my shoes, he came over and grabbed my elbow.

day5_archive_cycle12_71.text: Once you leave the nurse's office, you should come back to class. Don't walk on your own.

day5_archive_cycle12_72.text: As the darkroom door closed, a small sound of plywood being lifted could be heard from inside.

day5_archive_cycle12_73.text: The teacher didn't look back. I stretched out my hand, placed it on the wall, and slowed down until the sound stopped.

day5_archive_cycle12_74.text: The last photo on record only showed the bottom of the locker. The film canister was hidden beneath the plywood and not visible.

day5_archive_cycle12_75.text: When I returned to the server screen, my left hand felt tense. I wrote the three names on separate lines.

day5_archive_cycle12_76.text: Lee Junho, Choi Yuna, the thirteenth. I kept the names separate and closed the record with the blanks still there.

day5_history_callback_37.text: There was also a wet piece of paper in the bag. Instead of throwing away even the unreadable letters, I put them away from the prescription.

day5_history_callback_38.text: I filled out my notes in the order I recorded them at night. You did not mix what Seolhwa said and what was left in the document on the same line.

day5_history_callback_39.text: The record set the previous day was opened on the administrator screen. The inconsistencies I had identified now appeared to be editable.

day5_expansion_action_10_a.text: I looked straight at my face in the lens. Since it wasn't a photo that confirmed names, it was rather clear where to look.

day5_expansion_action_10_b.text: When I picked up the camera, Yuna stood in front of a blank wall. I took a step back and put my hand inside the frame.
